title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: Software and Cloud Services - Qualifying Purchases
summary: Explains which purchases count as “qualifying software and cloud” for the Business Platinum Rewards Card: SaaS subscriptions/enterprise software licenses, cloud infrastructure/platform/storage, and developer tools/analytics/productivity suites when billed under software or cloud services categories. Transactions in those categories earn 4.0% (otherwise 1.5%); hardware/on‑prem equipment, professional services/implementation/consulting, and telecom/internet charges not categorized as software/cloud are excluded, with tips to buy direct and verify merchant category coding and retain invoices.
faqs: What types of software and cloud purchases qualify for the enhanced 4.0% rewards rate?
